metadata.scope: 77 methods in root README model tables; scFM and benchmark rows excluded
metadata.score: Weighted Jaccard over curated architecture tags; family weights 3, autoencoder/diffusion parent 1, regulatory/factorization families 2, modules/details 1. Edges require at least one shared eligible family/module.
metadata.interpretation: Annotation-derived structural similarity, not measured functional similarity, performance, inheritance, or publication chronology.

nodes.name: Hodos et al.
nodes.features: Bulk expression: nearest-neighbor prediction and tensor completion for unmeasured drug–cell-type profiles.

nodes.name: scGen
nodes.features: VAE latent-space vector arithmetic transfers perturbation effects to held-out cell populations.

nodes.name: CellBox
nodes.features: Interpretable dynamical network model of signaling and viability responses, used to design cancer drug combinations.

nodes.name: chemCPA
nodes.features: Chemical-structure embeddings extend a compositional autoencoder to predict responses to unseen drugs.

nodes.name: MultiCPA
nodes.features: Compositional latent modeling of multimodal perturbation responses, including unseen combinations of measured interventions.

nodes.name: scPreGAN
nodes.features: Combines an autoencoder with adversarial generation to predict perturbed single-cell expression distributions.

nodes.name: CellOT
nodes.features: Learns neural optimal-transport maps between unpaired control and treated cell distributions; fits a map per perturbation.

nodes.name: CPA
nodes.features: Disentangles basal state, perturbations, and covariates; composes latent effects to predict doses and perturbation combinations.

nodes.name: GEARS
nodes.features: GO-derived perturbation graphs and coexpression graphs support prediction of unseen genetic perturbations and combinations.

nodes.name: ontoVAE
nodes.features: Ontology-structured VAE decoder yields interpretable pathway activities and supports in silico genetic/drug perturbations.

nodes.name: SAMS-VAE
nodes.features: Sparse additive perturbation embeddings compose with basal cell states in a VAE for response modeling.

nodes.name: scDiff
nodes.features: Conditional diffusion framework for multiple single-cell tasks, including perturbation-response prediction.

nodes.name: scVIDR
nodes.features: VAE with cell-type-specific latent response vectors and dose interpolation for chemical perturbations.

nodes.name: biolord
nodes.notes: Disentangled latent-code generator; no VAE posterior is inferred from the name or decoder alone.
nodes.features: Disentangles known attributes from residual cell variation and generates counterfactuals by changing attribute embeddings.

nodes.name: CODEX
nodes.features: Counterfactual deep learning predicts cancer-cell-line responses to unseen intervention combinations and can incorporate GO priors.

nodes.name: cycleCDR
nodes.features: Uses cycle-consistency constraints for bidirectional control–perturbed state mapping; evaluated on chemical and genetic responses.

nodes.name: PRnet
nodes.features: Conditions on compound structure and baseline expression to generate chemical responses at bulk and single-cell resolution.

nodes.name: scDisInFact
nodes.features: Disentangled VAE separates shared biology, condition-specific factors, and batch effects for integration and condition-response prediction.

nodes.name: scLAMBDA
nodes.features: VAE with language-model-derived gene embeddings separates basal and perturbation-specific representations for single/multi-gene prediction.

nodes.name: STAMP
nodes.features: Decomposes genetic-response prediction into differential-expression detection, change direction, and change magnitude.

nodes.name: TranSiGen
nodes.features: Self-supervised generative representations combine baseline expression and molecular structure to reconstruct chemical-induced transcriptional profiles.

nodes.name: CausalGRN
nodes.features: Infers a network skeleton, orients edges using CRISPR effects, and predicts downstream responses through the directed regulatory network.

nodes.name: CellFlow
nodes.features: Conditional flow matching generates cell-phenotype distributions for chemical, genetic, and signaling perturbations.

nodes.name: Cradle-VAE
nodes.features: Counterfactual artifact disentanglement separates technical effects from biological perturbation signals in a causal generative VAE.

nodes.name: GPerturb
nodes.features: Sparse Gaussian-process regression models gene-level perturbation effects and provides uncertainty estimates, including for dose responses.

nodes.name: IMPA
nodes.features: Conditional adversarial autoencoder transfers perturbation style to control-cell images to generate morphological responses.

nodes.name: PerturbNet
nodes.notes: Normalizing flow is annotated separately from flow-matching training.
nodes.features: Conditional normalizing flows link perturbation representations to cell-state distributions for unseen chemicals, gene interventions, and coding variants.

nodes.name: PRESAGE
nodes.features: Attention-based integration of diverse gene embeddings predicts expression responses to unmeasured genetic perturbations.

nodes.name: Scouter
nodes.features: Uses LLM-derived gene embeddings and a compressor–generator network to predict unseen genetic perturbation responses.

nodes.name: Squidiff
nodes.features: Diffusion-based generation models cell development and transcriptomic responses to perturbations.

nodes.name: Conditional Monge Gap
nodes.features: Conditional optimal transport models drug-, dose-, and combination-dependent single-cell response distributions.

nodes.name: CSTATE
nodes.features: Structural causal modeling over latent gene modules estimates intervention effects conditional on cellular context.

nodes.name: LCD
nodes.notes: Mechanistic latent causal SDE; not assigned to the denoising/masked generative diffusion family.
nodes.features: Latent causal diffusion models gene-regulatory dynamics and unseen perturbation combinations; CLIPR interprets direct causal effects.

nodes.name: MultiPert
nodes.notes: Includes a transcriptomic VAE and a proteomic autoencoder, plus dual attention.
nodes.features: Adversarial alignment and dual attention model perturbation responses across single-cell omics modalities.

nodes.name: PertAdapt
nodes.notes: Adapter module is annotated; no one backbone is assumed for every supported foundation model.
nodes.features: Adds a perturbation-conditioned adapter and adaptive loss to foundation models for genetic-response prediction.

nodes.name: PerturbDiff
nodes.features: Functional diffusion operates on population distributions to model hidden-context variation in perturbation responses.

nodes.name: PerturbLDM
nodes.features: Conditional latent diffusion generates single-cell responses in specified drug and cellular contexts.

nodes.name: PopPert
nodes.notes: Transformer predictor and Gaussian-copula population model (source paper, Fig. 2 and model overview).
nodes.features: Models population-level joint expression distributions with a low-rank Gaussian copula, including cross-gene dependencies.

nodes.name: PrePR-CT
nodes.features: Cell-type-specific graphs and inductive biological priors support interpretable drug-response prediction in limited-data settings.

nodes.name: scBalFlow
nodes.notes: Staged flow matching with Transformer generation (source architecture Fig. 2).
nodes.features: Staged flow matching separates response-intensity prediction from expression generation to address imbalanced drug responses.

nodes.name: scDFM
nodes.notes: Flow matching with a differential Transformer backbone (source paper, Fig. 1).
nodes.features: Conditional flow matching with population-distribution alignment predicts genetic and chemical responses from unpaired cell populations.

nodes.name: scDRP
nodes.features: Disentangles perturbation-dependent response from cell identity to estimate heterogeneous individual treatment effects.

nodes.name: scLDM
nodes.features: VAE compression and conditional latent diffusion generate responses conditioned on baseline cell state, cell type, and perturbation.

nodes.name: scPert
nodes.features: Transformer fuses LLM-derived gene embeddings with structured biological knowledge for single and combinatorial genetic-response prediction.

nodes.name: Stack
nodes.features: Cell-set foundation model uses prompt cells for in-context, counterfactual expression generation across cellular conditions.

nodes.name: STATE
nodes.features: Set-based transition model predicts context-dependent perturbation responses; observationally pretrained embeddings provide complementary cell-state information.

nodes.name: TxPert
nodes.features: Latent transfer integrates multiple gene-interaction knowledge graphs to predict genetic perturbation effects and cross-context responses.

nodes.name: UniPert-G2CP
nodes.features: Unifies genetic and chemical molecular representations, then transfers genetic-screen information to chemical phenotype prediction.

nodes.name: X-Cell
nodes.notes: Masked/remasking diffusion LM with a scGPT-initialized attention backbone; kept distinct from continuous denoising diffusion.
nodes.features: Diffusion language model uses multimodal biological priors to predict genetic perturbation responses across cellular contexts.

nodes.name: XPert
nodes.features: Biologically informed dual-branch transformer models baseline expression, drug-induced changes, and dose/time dependence.

nodes.name: CellDrift
nodes.features: Generalized linear models and functional data analysis identify temporal perturbation-response patterns across cell types.

nodes.name: CONCERT
nodes.features: Disentangles perturbation/state attributes and learns spatial Gaussian-process kernels for niche-aware counterfactual response prediction.

nodes.name: UNAGI
nodes.features: Learns disease-associated cellular dynamics and performs in silico gene/pathway/drug interventions for drug discovery and repurposing.

nodes.name: AlphaCell
nodes.notes: Multi-paradigm world-model framework; alternatives in the conceptual overview are not assigned as one fixed backbone.
nodes.features: World-model framework for simulating perturbation-induced cellular dynamics; described in a preprint.

nodes.name: Celcomen
nodes.features: Causal graph modeling separates intra- and inter-cellular regulation to generate counterfactual spatial transcriptomics.

nodes.name: RegVelo
nodes.features: Couples splicing kinetics with gene-regulatory interactions; supports in silico regulatory perturbation and cell-fate analysis.

nodes.name: BioDiscoveryAgent
nodes.features: LLM agent designs genetic perturbation experiments using biological knowledge and observed outcomes; experimental design rather than expression generation.

nodes.name: PDGrapher
nodes.features: Inverse design: causally inspired graph networks propose therapeutic target combinations to move a diseased state toward a treated state.

nodes.name: SequenTx
nodes.features: Combines a tumour cell-state model with reinforcement learning to design sequential drug treatments.

nodes.name: DTD
nodes.features: Drug–target–disease association prediction by relational tensor factorization; not a single-cell response generator.

nodes.name: scINSIGHT
nodes.features: Matrix factorization separates shared and condition-specific gene programs; an integration/interpretation method, not a response predictor.

nodes.name: CINEMA-OT
nodes.features: Separates treatment-associated signals from confounders and uses optimal transport to estimate single-cell treatment effects.

nodes.name: contrastiveVI
nodes.features: Separates target-specific variation from variation shared with background/control cells; a contrastive analysis model.

nodes.name: DREEP
nodes.features: Uses pharmacogenomic sensitivity signatures and enrichment to estimate drug vulnerability from tumour-cell expression; not transcriptome generation.

nodes.name: MOASL
nodes.features: Contrastive similarity learning predicts drug mechanisms of action from transcriptomic signatures.

nodes.name: sVAE
nodes.features: Models perturbations as sparse interventions on latent mechanisms to learn interpretable cellular representations.

nodes.name: Cell Painting CNN
nodes.features: Weakly supervised CNN learns morphological profiles from Cell Painting images; represents observed phenotypes rather than generating responses.

nodes.name: DRSPRING
nodes.features: GCN integrates chemical, interaction, and expression information to predict drug-pair synergy; endpoint is synergy, not cell-state generation.

nodes.name: PertKGE
nodes.features: Knowledge-graph embedding of perturbation transcriptomics infers compound–protein interactions for target identification and virtual screening.

nodes.name: SC-VAE
nodes.features: Guide-supervised contrastive VAE separates perturbation effects from baseline heterogeneity for perturbation interpretation.

nodes.name: scRank
nodes.features: Perturbs cell-type-specific regulatory networks in silico to rank drug-responsive populations from untreated scRNA-seq.

nodes.name: TAT
nodes.features: Transformer maps dose-dependent transcriptional profiles to compound activity in other assays; not a transcriptome-response generator.

nodes.name: CellCap
nodes.features: Sparse response programs and attention model how basal cell state shapes heterogeneous perturbation responses.

nodes.name: Pertpy
nodes.notes: Modular analysis toolkit; no single fixed architecture is assigned.
nodes.features: Modular perturbation-analysis toolkit covering datasets, annotations, distances, and statistical analyses; not one predictive model.

nodes.name: PS
nodes.features: Estimates continuous per-cell perturbation strength from downstream expression changes to resolve heterogeneous responses.

nodes.name: scAgents
nodes.features: Multi-agent analysis framework generates models and executable workflows for single-cell perturbation tasks; not one fixed predictor.

nodes.name: TRADE
nodes.features: Statistical model estimates the distribution and transcriptome-wide impact of differential-expression effects while accounting for estimation error.

edges.reason: Autoencoder; Denoising diffusion; Generative diffusion family; VAE
Adversarial generator / GAN; Graph neural network
